top_choice_rationale: P001 credits Drucker, Holst and Mojsov with a citation on GLP-1 physiology and its active form: a mature, independently confirmed chain from gut-hormone physiology to randomized outcome evidence in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease. The Mojsov versus Habener priority question and the omission of Knudsen are real credit risks, but a flawed-yet-defensible award of this scale is preferable to no award.
